t: This module behaves somewhat like the $(l:modules/extruder_1)Extruder Module Mk1/$, but with a few important differences:$(li)The Mk2 module doesn't place items from the router's buffer, but rather from a template defined within the module itself.$(li)This template appears on the right-hand side of the module's GUI, has 9 slots, and can have multiple items per slot. Items placed in the template are "ghost" items.
该模块行为与$(l:modules/extruder_1)造桥模块 Mk1/$相似，但存在若干关键差异：$(li)Mk2模块并非从路由器缓存中提取物品进行放置，而是依据模块自身定义的模板进行操作；$(li)该模板显示于模块GUI界面右侧，共含9个槽位，且每个槽位可容纳多种物品。置于模板中的物品均为“幽灵”物品。

$(li)Blocks extruded are "virtual" - effectively created out of nowhere, but drop nothing when broken and can't be crafted normally.$(li)Therefore, this module isn't suitable for farming like the Extruder Mk1, but can be used to place doors/bridges etc. with more complex patterns than the Mk1 could.$(li)The default range for the Extruder Mk2 is 24 blocks, which can be increased to 48 with Range Upgrades.
$(li)挤出的方块是“虚拟”方块——实际上是凭空生成的，但被破坏时不会掉落任何东西，也不能正常合成。$(li)因此，这个模块不像造桥模块 Mk1 那样适合农场用途，但它可以用来放置门、桥等，从而实现 Mk1 做不到的更复杂图案。$(li)造桥模块 Mk2 的默认范围是 24 格，可通过范围升级提高到 48 格。
